Transcriptome terminal now carries the NextSeq 75-cycle plan (61/8/8/14). Two source discrepancies displayed on the page: Supplementary Table 1 vs Table 2 for the R1-PCRix list, and the round-2 thermocycler row numbering (2-9 then 16) giving 8 or 14 cycles - the model states no count.
